summary: This Form 6-K filed by Corporación América Airports S.A. announces the convening of its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for May 13, 2026. The filing provides the meeting date, location at its registered office in Luxembourg, and the record date of April 17, 2026. Enclosures include the convening notice, proxy card, and reference to the company's 2025 financial statements and directors' compensation policy. This is a routine corporate governance filing and does not constitute a special situation event. No transactional terms, strategic changes, or activist involvement are present. The filing is a standard annual meeting notice with no special situation implications.
